variants.name: AS で短い名前を付ける・INNER JOIN と書く

inner: SELECT o.item, m.name FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN members AS m ON o.member_id = m.id ORDER BY o.id
ambiguous: SELECT o.id, m.name FROM orders o JOIN members m ON o.member_id = m.id ORDER BY o.id
left: SELECT m.name, o.item FROM members m LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.member_id = m.id ORDER BY m.id, o.id

variants.name: 小文字で書く・先に表を見る

inner: select item, name from orders join members on members.id = orders.member_id order by orders.id;
ambiguous: select orders.id, members.name from orders join members on members.id = orders.member_id order by orders.id;
left: select members.name, orders.item from members left outer join orders on members.id = orders.member_id order by members.id, orders.id;

wrong.why: `id` に表の名前を付けない
input: SELECT id, name FROM orders JOIN members ON orders.member_id = members.id
